# normalize differing AS schema and dedup IDs
frames=[]
for f in files:
 d=pd.read_csv(f)
 if 'date_utc' in d: d=d.rename(columns={'date_utc':'date','sched_dep_utc':'sched_dep','actual_dep_utc':'actual_dep'})
 frames.append(d)
df=pd.concat(frames,ignore_index=True).drop_duplicates('flight_id')
df['route']=df.apply(lambda r:'-'.join(sorted([r['origin'],r['dest']])),axis=1)
counts=df.groupby('route').size().sort_values(ascending=False)
print('rows',len(df),'date range',df.date.min(),df.date.max(),'routes',len(counts))
print(counts.head(15).to_string())
print('top5',counts.head(5).index.tolist())
